items: README-to-implementation ceilings: source equation/hidden-context/baseline/candidate descriptions diverge from frozen code; context is observed; internal mutation can precede stated holdout gate; compute is not measured; implemented insufficiency is missing interaction structure rather than missing observation.
Environment observation exposes target as well as predictors; current agents ignore observation target for prediction but interface does not enforce target blindness.

Hypothesis/feature interface ceilings: transform feature shapes differ from REE feature paths; augment is stochastic per call, is not scored internally, and evaluator maps augment to contextual interaction instead of its own transform.
State-vs-REE control gap: baseline fixed feature sets and semantics differ, and implemented baseline is not the one-parameter theta*v representation described in README.

REE mutation ceilings: null and interaction scores are heterogeneous; correlation is not heldout predictive evidence; automatic mutation is hard-limited to one; torsion is recent MAE while violation_history is unused in trigger; sparse-mutation behavior is partly structurally enforced.

Evaluator ceilings: train inputs are unused; models are fit/scored on validation data; residual metric switches RSS-vs-MSE behavior; intervention_gain is unmeasured/default zero; complexity penalty is uncalibrated.

Run-level ceilings: scored-candidate tuples conflict with evaluator/logging API; internal commit can precede evaluator; next_state is discarded; random trajectories are not paired; false-mutation/recovery/post-shift metrics are heuristic or scope-mismatched; compute is absent; no frozen execution provenance; assertions are criteria; comparator changes representation access/inductive bias/mutation authority together.
